title: CaliberCos Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: CaliberCos Inc. (CWD) filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 announcing the completion of the second round of its Noteholder Conversion Program, resulting in the conversion of approximately $3.4 million of unsecured corporate notes into equity and preferred stock. This is a routine corporate debt restructuring announcement for a small-cap company and contains no content relevant to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: CaliberCos Inc. completed the second round of its Noteholder Conversion Program on April 14, 2026
Approximately $1.9 million of unsecured corporate notes were converted into Class A common stock
Approximately $1.5 million of unsecured corporate notes were converted into Series AAA Convertible Preferred Stock
The filing was signed by CEO John C. Loeffler II on April 15, 2026
The company is an emerging growth company as defined by Rule 405 of the Securities Act
